task.summary: Default task

**Add initial setup for Klippy project.**
Includes: - .editorconfig for formatting consistency. - .gitattributes for normalized EOL handling. - export_presets.cfg for Godot export settings. - Godot project resources and configuration files (Klippy.cs, icon.svg, Klippy.tscn). - Initial C# script for Klippy behavior.
Remove klippy.pck that was created by accident

Add angular velocity and rolling behavior to Klippy movement
Includes: - Introduced `_angularVelocity` and `RollRadius` for rolling motion. - Adjusted bounce physics to account for rotational effects. - Enhanced passthrough mask updates to handle sprite rotation dynamically.

Add spin recovery mechanic to Klippy movement
Includes: - Introduced `SpinRecoveryRate` for smoothing sprite rotation back to default. - Updated passthrough mask dynamically based on rotation changes.

Add hitbox visualization toggle to Klippy
Includes: - Added `_showHitbox` flag for enabling/disabling hitbox rendering. - Implemented F1 key toggle for hitbox visibility. - Updated `_Draw` method to render hitbox when enabled. - Integrated redraw calls to maintain real-time hitbox updates.
Enable C# support and adjust project configuration settings
Remove Klippy resources, project files, and configurations

Add draggable Klippy node with bounce and spin mechanics
Includes: - Implemented draggable functionality with velocity and angular velocity handling. - Added bounce physics with damping and rolling behavior. - Integrated hitbox visualization toggle and passthrough mask updates. - Configured transparent window and tailored project settings.

Fix type in `Bitmap` creation and adjust window settings
- Corrected `Bitmap` to `BitMap` in `Klippy.gd`. - Updated `project.godot` window configuration: - Disabled resizable window. - Ensured per-pixel transparency is allowed.

Add context menu and resize functionality to Klippy
- Implemented context menu with resize and close options. - Added dynamic resize functionality based on predefined size steps. - Updated hitbox and passthrough mask calculations to reflect size changes.

Add smooth dragging and dynamic physical properties to Klippy
- Introduced `_recompute_physical_properties` for mass and roll radius adjustments based on size. - Enhanced dragging mechanics with velocity smoothing and mass-dependent follow rate. - Refactored size update logic to incorporate physical property recalculations.

Add DVD mode and settings window to Klippy
- Added DVD mode with bouncing window mechanics. - Implemented settings window with basic popup functionality. - Extended context menu with options for DVD mode and settings access. - Adjusted input and dragging logic to integrate new features.

Add SpeechBubble and Dialogue systems with interactions
- Introduced `SpeechBubble` for displaying anchored text above windows, with auto-hide and repositioning mechanics. - Added `Dialogue` class to handle random greetings and complaints. - Integrated double-click greetings and bounce-triggered complaints into Klippy's interactions. - Included probabilistic logic and cooldown system for complaint generation.

Add SpeechBubble and Dialogue systems with interactions
- Introduced `SpeechBubble` for displaying anchored text above windows, with auto-hide and repositioning mechanics. - Added `Dialogue` class to handle random greetings and complaints. - Integrated double-click greetings and bounce-triggered complaints into Klippy's interactions. - Included probabilistic logic and cooldown system for complaint generation.

Add feeding system with stats management to Klippy
- Introduced `PetStats` to track and emit hunger and feeding states. - Added `SettingsPanel` with toggles for feeding and hunger visibility. - Enabled feeding through context menu with dynamic state management. - Integrated hunger updates with real-time UI feedback.

Add `StatusTooltip` and enhance food tracking
- Introduced `StatusTooltip` for displaying dynamic status above windows with real-time repositioning. - Replaced hunger mechanics with food tracking, including decay, feeding, and death states. - Updated `PetStats` and `SettingsPanel` to reflect food-based behavior. - Integrated hover

Add `StatusTooltip` and enhance food tracking
- Introduced `StatusTooltip` for displaying dynamic status above windows with real-time repositioning. - Replaced hunger mechanics with food tracking, including decay, feeding, and death states. - Updated `PetStats` and `SettingsPanel` to reflect food-based behavior.

Add save/load system and improve settings/state management
- Introduced `SaveData` utility for saving and loading game state. - Enhanced `SettingsPanel` with a toggle for food visibility and emitted a signal for updates. - Implemented offline decay mechanic in `PetStats` to apply food decay during inactivity. - Updated `Klippy` to persist state across sessions, including size, food, and settings. - Replaced quit logic with a save-before-exit function to ensure data integrity.

Add mood tracking and integrate with food mechanics
- Introduced `mood` property with decay and improvement rates based on food levels. - Added `mood_changed` signal for real-time updates. - Implemented `_update_mood` to adjust mood dynamically with food thresholds. - Refactored offline decay to apply both food and mood changes during inactivity. - Enhanced save/load system to persist mood state.

Replace `StatusTooltip` with `StatusDialog` for improved status display
- Removed `StatusTooltip` and its hover-based mechanics. - Introduced `StatusDialog` for detailed status viewing via context menu. - Added mood tracking integration to `StatusDialog` with real-time updates. - Updated `Klippy` to replace tooltip logic with dialog-based interaction.

Add mood value toggles and size selection to settings
- Added toggles for showing detailed food and mood values in `SettingsPanel` and `StatusDialog`. - Implemented size selection with dynamic update in `SettingsPanel`. - Updated `Klippy` to save and apply user preferences for mood, food, and size. - Enhanced `StatusDialog` to display detailed food and mood levels.

Add confirmation dialog for closing Klippy
- Replaced direct close action with a confirmation dialog in the context menu. - Updated context menu item text to "Close Klippy" for clarity. - Implemented confirmation dialog with "Close Klippy?" prompt and connected it to the quit logic.

Introduce `PetBody` base class and `FoodBody` feeding mechanic
- Added `PetBody` class to standardize physics interactions and dragging logic for all pet-related objects. - Implemented `FoodBody` to handle window-based feeding mechanics, interacting with `PetStats` via collision. - Refactored `Klippy` to inherit from `PetBody`, centralizing common physics and interaction logic. - Adjusted `Stats.gd` to use dynamic feeding amounts instead of a fixed value.

Limit feeding items to a maximum and update feed menu state dynamically
- Introduced `MAX_FOOD_ITEMS` constant to cap the number of food items. - Added `active_food_items` array to track current food items. - Updated feeding logic to disable context menu option when limit is reached. - Implemented dynamic state updates for food spawning and removal using `_update_feed_menu_state`.
Add UID files for `FoodBody` and `PetBody` classes
Prevent feeding logic from executing while dragging

Add revive mechanics and integrate with context menu
- Introduced `revive()` method to reset `is_dead` state and restore food levels. - Added revive option to the context menu, dynamically shown based on death state. - Updated complaints and double-click interactions to respect the `is_dead` state.

Add health mechanics and integrate with UI and stats system
- Introduced `health` property with decay, regeneration, and status thresholds. - Added `health_changed` signal for real-time updates. - Enhanced `StatusDialog` and `SettingsPanel` with health value toggles and displays. - Adjusted mood logic to consider health status. - Updated save/load system to persist health state.

Add health mechanics and integrate with UI and stats system
- Introduced `health` property with decay, regeneration, and status thresholds. - Added `health_changed` signal for real-time updates. - Enhanced `StatusDialog` and `SettingsPanel` with health value toggles and displays. - Adjusted mood logic to consider health status. - Updated save/load system to persist health state.

Add bounce impact speed handling and idle animations for pets
- Added `impact_speed` parameter to `_on_energetic_bounce` to apply throw damage only at high speeds. - Introduced idle bouncing animation for hungry pets. - Adjusted idle and DVD modes to handle animations dynamically.

Increase impact speed threshold for damage calculation
- Updated `DAMAGE_SPEED_THRESHOLD` in `Klippy.gd` from 400.0 to 800.0.

Add developer tools dialog and state system refactor
- Introduced `DevToolsDialog` to allow manual adjustment of pet stats with UI controls. - Added `state` property and `State` enum to replace `dragging` boolean in `PetBody`. - Refactored physics and input handling to accommodate state transitions (`IDLE`, `DRAGGING`, `THROWN`). - Updated `SettingsPanel` and context menu to toggle developer tools visibility. - Implemented debug methods in `Stats.gd` for direct stat modification.

Update idle bounce mechanics and health regeneration logic
- Refactored idle bounce behavior for hungry pets with configurable burst intervals and cycles. - Added stricter type annotation for health regeneration in `Stats.gd`.

Add bounce trigger button and adjust mood/health mechanics
- Added `bounce_triggered` signal and UI button to manually trigger idle bounce behavior in `DevToolsDialog`. - Updated mood/health rates in `Stats.gd` for improved progression balance. - Refined idle bounce logic to integrate manual triggers and reset behavior dynamically.

Refine hungry bounce logic with envelope scaling
- Added `_bounce_envelope` function to scale bounce amplitude dynamically across cycles. - Introduced `HUNGRY_BOUNCE_ENVELOPE_MIN_SCALE` constant for

Improved bouncing
- Added `_bounce_envelope` function to scale bounce amplitude dynamically across cycles. - Introduced `HUNGRY_BOUNCE_ENVELOPE_MIN_SCALE` constant for

Add play tracking and mood boost mechanics
- Introduced `apply_play_boost` method in `Stats.gd` to adjust mood based on play activity. - Added play tracking logic using distance thresholds in `Klippy.gd`. - Integrated health and mood conditions to trigger the play mood boost.

Adjust play mood boost scaling
- Reduced `PLAY_MOOD_BOOST` constant in `Klippy.gd` from 3.0 to 1.5 for better balancing.
Limit FPS to 30 and adjust physics tick rate for performance optimization

Add VSync toggle and FPS selection to settings panel
- Introduced `vsync_toggled` and `fps_selected` signals in `SettingsPanel`. - Added VSync checkbox and FPS selection dropdown to the settings UI. - Integrated new settings with `Klippy.gd` to apply changes dynamically using `_apply_display_settings`. - Extended save/load system to persist VSync and FPS settings.
Add initial README with project overview, requirements, features, and export instructions
Update `.idea/workspace.xml` with task tracking and new edit completion features

Add drag spin mechanics and improve rotation recovery logic
- Introduced `drag_spin_target` with mouse wheel adjustment for spin control during dragging. - Enhanced sprite rotation recovery to seamlessly align with `drag_spin_target`. - Refactored input handling in `PetBody.gd` to incorporate new spin mechanics.

Refactor food spawning and consumption logic to reduce memory
- Introduced `consumed` signal in `FoodBody` to handle food item lifecycle. - Added object pooling for efficient reuse of food windows. - Reduced maximum food items to 8 for better performance and management. - Modularized UI logic for settings, status, and confirmation dialogs.

Refactor food mechanics and update project structure
- Introduced `active_food_items` and `food_window_pool` arrays for efficient food management. - Added constants (`FOOD_WINDOW_SIZE`, `FOOD_MASS`, `MAX_FOOD_ITEMS`) in `Klippy.gd`. - Adjusted `.idea/workspace.xml` and `project.godot` for updated configurations and directory

Refactor food mechanics and update project structure
- Introduced `active_food_items` and `food_window_pool` arrays for efficient food management. - Added constants (`FOOD_WINDOW_SIZE`, `FOOD_MASS`, `MAX_FOOD_ITEMS`) in `Klippy.gd`. - Adjusted `.idea/workspace.xml structure. - Moved `FoodBagBody.gd` and related files to `features/food` for modularity.
Fixed my bad merge.
Prevent collision logic execution when window is not visible

Refactor food bag system with art assets and collision improvements
- Replaced procedural bag rendering with preloaded textures for visual consistency. - Introduced `KlippyFoodBag.png` and `KlippyFoodBagBack.png` as assets for bag visuals. - Updated bag implementation to use `interior_polygon` for dynamic containment checks. - Enhanced collision logic to account for wall outlines and bag interior using traced polygons. - Redesigned food spawning offsets and state flow for better alignment with visuals. - Removed obsolete procedural graphics methods for bag rendering from `FoodBagBody.gd`.
